description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Add 1–50 uploaded audio tracks to a brand library atomically. First use upload_media for each file, POST its raw bytes to uploadUrl with Content-Type audio/mpeg (or the actual audio type), then pass the returned storageId and track metadata here. Include source, licenseCode and attribution; madeOn records the generation date for Suno music. No music generation or Ember charge. All tracks save or none do. Use stable externalIds from the manifest; list and compare them before retrying an uncertain result. Duplicates reject the whole batch.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/music/tracks.)

brandId.description: Brand id or personal. Omit to use the key’s bound brand, otherwise the owner’s active brand.

adRightsConfirmed.description: For commissioned tracks: the agreement covers advertising.

externalId.description: Stable manifest/source id. Duplicates within this brand and origin are rejected, including archived tracks.

madeOn.description: Generation date (YYYY-MM-DD); records when the Suno/ElevenLabs plan rights applied.

source.description: For example suno, commissioned, own, or a library name.

sourceUrl.description: HTTP(S) credit link to the track or its library.

storageId.description: From POSTing audio bytes to a /api/v2/media/upload-url URL. Audio only, at most 50 MiB per file.

name: music_tracks_create
title: Add music tracks
